info.title: daventry
info.description: Command line player for Sierra AGI and SCI games: dotnet tool install -g Daventry.Player, then daventry <game folder>.

options.name: --scale
options.description: initial window or screenshot scale factor (default 3); the window can be resized

options.name: --fullscreen
options.description: start in full screen (Alt+Enter or F11 toggles it while playing)

options.name: --aspect
options.description: show the picture at 4:3 as a CRT did (Ctrl+Alt+A toggles it while playing)

options.name: --frames
options.description: exit after N ticks (for smoke tests)

options.name: --list
options.description: detect and print games, do not run

options.name: --info
options.description: load every resource and print statistics, do not run

options.name: --picture
options.description: start in the picture viewer at picture N (AGI and SCI)

options.name: --view
options.description: place view N on the picture as ego (AGI cycles its cels; SCI: L and C step loops and cels)

options.name: --screenshot
options.description: render headless and write the frame as PNG, do not open a window

options.name: --wav
options.description: headless: also write the audio the engine played as a WAV

options.name: --enter-every
options.description: headless: press Enter every N ticks

options.name: --type
options.description: headless: type text and Enter at tick T

options.name: --key
options.description: headless: press a key (escape, return, up, f1, ...) at tick T

options.name: --click
options.description: headless: click the left mouse button at (x, y) at tick T

options.name: --save
options.description: headless: save the game to slot N at tick T

options.name: --restore
options.description: headless: restore slot N at tick T (SCI)

options.name: --saves
options.description: headless: folder for saved games (default: in memory)

options.name: --seed
options.description: headless: seed for the games' random numbers (default 1; a headless run repeats exactly)

options.name: --sound
options.description: sound hardware: AGI pcjr (default), pc, ramp, amiga or mac; SCI adlib (default), pcjr or pc

options.name: --no-digital-sfx
options.description: SCI: play the AdLib version of sound effects that also have a digital sample

options.name: --volume
options.description: master volume in percent (default 75, ScummVM's level); Ctrl+Alt+Up/Down and Ctrl+Alt+M while playing

options.name: --verbose
options.description: debug logging
